pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice (Let's Chat!)
pro_course_detail.description:
🌟 Improve Your Conversational English! 🌟

Speaking confidently in a foreign language can be one of the hardest parts of learning—trust me, I know from experience! That’s why it’s important to learn with someone who is:

✅ Encouraging
✅ Non-judgmental
✅ Patient

💬 What’s the goal of this lesson?
The aim is to help you communicate freely and informally, improving your conversational English in a relaxed and supportive environment. You’ll have the freedom to focus on any topic or specific area you’d like to improve, including:

🔹 Vocabulary
🔹 Grammar
🔹 Pronunciation
🔹 Oral fluency

✨ What will we cover?
Each lesson will be tailored to your needs, and over time, we’ll expand your knowledge to include natural speech patterns used by native English speakers, such as:

🗣️ Common sentence structures
💡 Everyday phrases & expressions
📚 A variety of useful vocabulary
🎭 Idioms & natural-sounding speech

👥 Who is this for?
This lesson is suitable for all levels—from absolute beginners to fluent speakers! We’ll keep topics and sentence structures at your level and progressively build your confidence in real-life conversations.

Let’s start improving your conversational English today! 🚀

pro_course_detail.description:
Do you need to work on your English for work, study or travel? These lessons are a fantastic opportunity to build on what you already know and increase your confidence. They are friendly, fun and varied, and we work at the right pace for you.

Each lesson will have a new topic, and will be divided into sections. After getting warmed up, we will spend some time on a language point, such as useful vocabulary or practising a point of grammar. I use a range of texts and activities to make this part interesting, such as film trailers, flashcards and pictures. Next, we have some freer discussion to improve spoken fluency. I will ask you a series of questions on the topic to give you the opportunity to practice what you know.

The lesson ends with an error correction session. This is a few minutes to think about the accuracy of your spoken English, where I tell you about any mistakes that you commonly make. You will usually find that you know how to correct them already.

I will give you a short homework, which is often a podcast episode about 5 minutes long on the topic of our lesson. We will discuss what you heard at the beginning of the next class.

We get a lot done in these classes while having fun, so make a booking and I'll look forward to meeting you!

course_info.trial_description:
Here’s what we’re going to do in this lesson:

Self-introductions: We'll start by introducing ourselves. You tell me a bit about you, and I’ll do the same!

Your English journey: I want to know how you’d like to learn. Do you prefer fun games, talking a lot, reading, or something else?

Your interests: What do you like? Hobbies, favorite movies, music, anything! This helps me make our lessons more exciting for you.

Motivations: Why are you learning English? Is it for travel, work, fun, or something else?

Check your English level: Don’t worry! I’ll listen and check your English level based on something called the CEFR scale (A1-C2).

Future lesson plan: Together, we’ll make a plan for your next lessons that will help you improve and enjoy learning.

Sounds good? Let’s have some fun and learn English together!

pro_course_detail.title: Free Talking English Conversation Class
pro_course_detail.description: Welcome to my free-talking English conversation class! Here, you can practice speaking English in a relaxed, supportive environment. There’s no need to worry about being perfect—this class is all about building confidence and speaking naturally. We'll chat about topics you enjoy, work on improving your fluency, and I'll help you sound more natural and comfortable in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Read & Discuss Newspaper Articles!
pro_course_detail.description:
Read & Discuss Newspaper Articles!
In this lesson, we’ll dive into interesting news articles together!

Here’s how it works:

Read together: We’ll pick a newspaper article that interests you—current events, entertainment, sports.

Build vocabulary: I’ll help you understand new words and phrases as we go.

Talk it out: We’ll chat about the article, share opinions, and practice speaking in real-world situations.

Improve comprehension: This lesson will help you get better at reading and understanding real English, just like you’d see in everyday life.

It’s a great way to stay informed and level up your English at the same time!

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have Qualified Teacher Status - the licence needed to teach in English State Education, and nine years of teaching experience and expertise. I love to include plenty of speaking opportunities in my lessons as I believe that they are vital to help you become confident and proficient. I can also help you with general English, for example, grammar and creative writing. I structure my lessons according to your needs. teacher_info.teaching_style:
As an English teacher in Multicultural London, I have taught non-native students, who have come to live in the UK from all around the world. Many of my students have naturally felt very nervous about starting to speak English, and so it is very rewarding for me to see them develop confidence. I use various strategies to help my students gain this independence: role-play, gesture, props, picture word banks, scaffold sentences and clear pronunciation. In addition, I will speak English at a speed that is suitable for you. 
I also plan and prepare interesting topics that are relevant to you and your life for us to talk about.

I look forward to meeting you in your trial lesson.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
As a teacher, I prioritise creating a supportive, patient, environment for learning. I am here to encourage and help you in your language learning journey, as I know what a long and challenging process it can be!

Two other features that characterise me as a teacher are related to my academic background. With a BSc in Anthropology, I am passionate about learning about different cultures and sharing my own knowledge about British culture. My recently completed MSc in Applied Linguistics for Language Teaching has also helped bring me up to date with the latest academic research in the field of second language acquisition, and apply this knowledge in my own teaching.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
It is very important to me to create a very interactive environment, where you are the one doing most of the speaking. I also like to create a relaxed, supportive environment for classes where we embrace mistakes as part of the learning process, rather than something to fear!

My teaching style is based on creating highly personalised, student-centred classes, respecting your goals, interests, and needs. I believe that we learn best when we focus on subject matter that is relevant and engaging for us, and I like to give you the opportunity to shape our class focus and style as much as possible.

exp_info.description: I worked as a researcher and translator at the Universidad de Granada, within the EU H2020 project PERCEPTIONS. The project researched how migrants or potential migrants see Europe, and involved interviews, focus groups, and surveys with migrants and first-line practitioners.

teaching_experience.description:
I currently work as a freelance English language teacher and am passionate about helping my students improve their language skills in a patient, supportive environment.

I work with adults, giving one-to-one or small group classes. I focus on a student-centred approach to teaching, with highly personalised, interactive classes. I specialise in teaching speaking and pronunciation for upper-intermediate and advanced students.

I worked as an online academic English tutor as part of a large pre-sessional program at the University of Manchester. 

I delivered classes focused on academic reading, writing, speaking, and listening to Chinese and Korean postgraduate offer holders.
